library(readr)

colnames(cuda_results) = c("algorithm", "n", "2_n", "s")
parallel_results <- read_csv("parallel-results.csv", col_names=FALSE,
                         col_types=c("c", "i", "i", "d"))
colnames(parallel_results) = c("algorithm", "n", "2_n", "s")
serial_results <- read_csv("serial-results.csv", col_names=FALSE,

colnames(serial_results) = c("algorithm", "n", "2_n", "s")
